_source: overhead 2/Background.vb loadBackground, Camera.vb initCamera, Cube.vb loadCube, Objects.vb checkDrawOrder and Engine.oneFrameRender, RECONSTRUCTION 2.4 and 3.1 to 3.3. Files are paths under the original's folder, exactly as they are on disk.

grid._note: area(10,10): slot (letter, number) sits at x = startX + (number - 1), y = startY + 1 - letter index (row A at the top). A tile spans x 0 to size and y -size/2 to +size/2 from its slot.

camera._note: PerspectiveFovLH(PI/4, 4/3, 0, 100) looking along +Z from cam; Z clamped to [-3.5, -1] unless free camera; renderRange = 1 + |cam.Z|, tested per axis. The original's near plane of 0 is not a valid Unity plane, so the nearest valid one is used (BIBLE).

backdrop._note: renderCube: a unit box scaled 67 x 55 x 38 around the origin, textured with menu.png, drawn first each frame; the frame is cleared to opaque magenta.

cursor._note: Cursor/Cursor.vb loadCursor, renderCursor, checkCursorEdge and Input.getMouse: a 0.05 quad drawn at the cursor + (0.02, -0.042), moved by the mouse's relative motion x 0.00172 (one pixel at zoom -1); a virtual 640 x 480 mouse held 32 px in from every edge decides the edges, where the cursor is put at the camera + edgeSnap and shows a scroll arrow; zoom while the middle button is held, the eye in examine mode, the arrow otherwise.

cameraControl._note: camSPD 0.02: edge scroll by camSPD (x3 with Shift) while the leader is within scrollLimits, the camera then held within them; carried by the leader's velocity beyond carryBeyond (checkHeroEdge); centring (CenterOnHero) adds camSPD x 8 x the distance to the leader + heroSize x (1/2, -1/2) + centreOffset each tick, moving the cursor with it, until within 0.05 of that point + centreArriveOffset; wheel zoom 0.15 per step; middle-button drag zoom camSPD / 10 x (centre y - mouse y) outside a 5 px dead zone; numpad strafe 0.05 / 0.02 and X / Z isometric 0.25 (RECONSTRUCTION 3.2, 5.3).

teamButton._note: Gui/TeamBtn.vb and Cursor2D.rendercursor2D, RECONSTRUCTION 13: a 28 x 28 square of the virtual 640 x 480 screen (y down) at (18, 75), drawn after the world, showing icon_team while the team follows and icon_solo while it kneels (the pictures are 32 x 30, stretched to the square). The left button toggles the team while the virtual mouse is across the button's width and between its top + hitTopBottom[0] and its bottom + hitTopBottom[1] (inclusive).

objects._note: checkDrawOrder: the heroes, the prop bottoms and the heroes' weapons. A hero stands facing Right on its stand sprite; a weapon shows texBlank (all colour key) unless its hero is drawing or in battle.
